identity.title: Atacama Compact Array Measurements of the Molecular Mass in the NGC 5044 Cooling-flow Group

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present CO observations of the early type galaxy NGC 5044, which resides at the center of an X-ray bright group with a moderate cooling flow.

evidence.quote: We adopt a systemic velocity of $\SI{2757}{km\,s^{-1}}$ (heliocentric) for NGC 5044 and a luminosity distance of $\SI{31.2}{Mpc}$ ((cite: Tonry2001-wi))
We adopt a systemic velocity of $\SI{2757}{km\,s^{-1}}$ (heliocentric) for NGC 5044 and a luminosity distance of $\SI{31.2}{Mpc}$ ((cite: Tonry2001-wi))

question.value: How much molecular gas is in NGC 5044, how is it distributed in clouds and on which scales, and where are the absorbing clouds relative to the AGN, using ACA 7m+TP CO(2-1) data

evidence.quote: We demonstrate, using the 7m array data, that we can recover the total flux inferred from IRAM 30m single dish observations, which corresponds to a total molecular mass of about $\SI{4e7}{M_\odot}$.
Project Code | 2011.0.00735.S
All ACA and ALMA observations were configured to provide four spectral windows within Band 6, each with a bandwidth of $\SI{185}{MHz}$.
The central frequencies for the other three spectral windows were $\SI{226.418}{GHz}$, $\SI{242.314}{GHz}$, and $\SI{244.244}{GHz}$.
$\nu_{ul}=\SI{230.538}{GHz}$ is the frequency of the CO(2-1) transition

evidence.quote: NGC 5044 was observed in cycle 4 with two different ALMA configurations (compact and extended) and with the ACA (7m array plus antennae for total power measurements).
